evidence_snippets: Image You train, test, and validate the machine learning model with example images that are annotated with labels for classification, or annotated with labels and bounding boxes for object detection.

For example, for a single set of images you can have one annotation set with bounding box and label information to do object detection, and also have another annotation set with just label annotations for classification.

If you are trying to classify house images that were all taken in snowy winter weather, you probably won't get great performance from a model trained only on house images taken in sunny weather even if you've tagged them with the classes you're interested in, as the lighting and scenery may be different enough to affect performance.
